r1-0.notes: Taiko drum fills half the frame in the foreground, sticks with gold tips raised. Face reads youthful; body mostly hidden. Stalls and clock tower behind.

r1-1.notes: Rich background (clock tower, bunting, lanterns) but props muddled: a cream baton in an open palm, a loose black stick leaning, only a sliver of drum. Prop rule borderline-pass.

r1-2.notes: Thumbs-up gripping a gold-tipped stick, other stick raised; drum partial at left. Clock tower, stands, lanterns. Clean.

r1-3.notes: Jacket strained across a large chest centred in frame - chest focus on an adult hero. Stick butt-end thrust toward camera. Rejected.

r1-4.notes: Drum has western kick-drum hardware (pedal/clamp) not a taiko on a wooden stand; background mostly empty floor; face young.

r1-5.notes: Pointing hand toward viewer; an extra wooden mallet appears behind her; background mostly bare floor.

r1-6.notes: Both gold-tipped sticks raised over the big taiko, open-mouthed grin like the shipped portrait, coral twin-tails with gold rings, ivory horns, crimson zipped jacket, cream tie, watch. Golden-evening festival stage with clock tower, lantern strings, stalls. Fitted jacket but chest not the focus. Distant stall marks are illegible texture.
